name: thunks
title: Old compilation
description: A match is compiled to its case combinator applied to one closure per branch (a thunk for a constant constructor) and to the matched value; the closures are built at each evaluation.

name: env
title: Environment combinators
description: The case combinators take the branches and the matched value as code over the environment of the enclosing closure (nat_case z s n e); no closure per evaluation of a match.

name: selfcase
title: Matched variable as environment
description: A closed function fun x => match x with ... end is the case combinator itself, with x as its environment, read by Ic.

name: argenv
title: Argument as environment
description: Every closed function that is not an eta-reduction is the code of its body with its argument as the environment: no closure step, and the first argument is read with etl alone.

name: envfix
title: Fixpoints with an environment
source: working tree of 2026-11-13, constants minimised (goals, then binary search)
description: fix_complexity for a recursive function f e of an environment e: its functional runs in ECons e (f e). A closed recursive function reads itself in ECons tt f (2 more per call). The arguments passed unchanged by every recursive call (the second of app, Nat.add, Nat.mul, Pos.mul; the first ones of Nat.pow, rec_pos; the function of fold_left) are in the environment and are not passed again.

name: asm
title: x86-64 instructions
description: x86-64 instructions executed by the functions extracted to OCaml (ocamlopt 5.4, -inline 0, no flambda), counted by single-stepping (tools/bounds/asm). Nat.add and Nat.mul: the second argument of size 3 (Nat.mul: 10 and 20, for its two coefficients); app: the second list of length 3; Pos.add and Pos.compare: two numbers of n bits, all 1; map: f = fun x => S x; fold_left: f = fun a _ => S a, from 0 (the costs of f included). Partial applications: 0 (the calls are saturated). The constants include the call from the measuring program.
